fullContentHtml:
NICL Assistant Result 2026 – Full Details

National Insurance Company Limited (NICL) has released result for the post of Assistants. This recruitment was released for 500 posts. Applications for the NICL Assistant Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 18 July 2026, to 07 August 2026. The online examination was held on 27 August 2026. Candidates who had appeared in this examination can download their NICL Assistant Result 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 18 July 2026
  • Last Date : 07 August 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 07 August 2026
  • Phase I Exam Date : 27 August 2026
  • Admit Card : 20 August 2026
  • Result : 08 October 2026
  • Phase II Exam Date : 30 October 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 850/-
  • SC, ST, PH : Rs. 00/-

How to Check Result

  1. Click on the direct official result link provided below.
  2. Enter your Roll Number / Registration Number and Date of Birth.
  3. Submit the form to view your scorecard on screen.
  4. Download and print a copy of the result for future reference.

Important Links

  • Download Result
  • Download Admit Card
  • Apply Online
  • Download Notification
  • Official Website

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is NICL Assistant Result 2026?

NICL Assistant Result 2026 is the official result announcement. Candidates can check their scorecard and merit status via the direct link above.

Where can I find the official direct link?

All verified official links are available in the Important Links table above on this page.
